in_arabic.name: سيمي
in_arabic.meaning: سيمي تعني الشخص الذي له وجه مشرق وجميل

in_urdu.name: سیمی
in_urdu.meaning: سیمی کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور روشن چہرہ

in_english.name: Seemi
in_english.meaning: Seemi means having a beautiful and radiant face
in_english.long_meaning: The name Seemi originates from the Arabic root 'س-ي-م' (s-ee-m), meaning 'beautiful face' or 'radiant face'. It signifies an individual with both inner and outer beauty. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with praiseworthy personalities. The name reflects a person with a shining personality, embodying beauty and light.
